description: Branch R-FMT-2 NUMERIC (precision/scale endpoints, public side) on a ACCDB. After CreateDatabase and close, ADO DDL (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) creates one table per precision and scale: DECIMAL(1,0), (2,1), (5,2), (18,4), (28,0), (28,28), (28,10), (29,0), (38,0), (38,10), each statement on its own so an ACE refusal of a form is an observation. Then DAO reads each field's Type, Size, Attributes and property list (Precision, Scale). Values are written as SQL numeric literals of at most 15 significant digits (ties at the next digit, one unit over the precision, negative zero as -0.00, a value needing more scale) and the long integers as BSTR integer text, each with dbFailOnError and a marked Errors read; rows are read through SQL CStr. Asks which forms ACE creates, and whether an over-scale value rounds (which way at a tie) or is refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
